## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Validation

- [ ] List the checks run and their results; confirm applicable CI jobs pass before merge.
- [ ] Update the relevant specs and user-facing documentation.
- [ ] For a new dependency or bundled model, document its license, attribution, security implications, and image/profile membership.
- [ ] Do not include private documents, personal data, credentials, or secrets.
